name: The Wood Mill
old_description: Custom Kitchens, Bathroom Vanities, Built-Ins, and More Built Right Here on the Mississippi Gulf Coast.
about:
The Wood Mill operates from Waveland, Mississippi, on the Gulf Coast. The company has served the region for more than 20 years, building custom cabinetry in its own workshop.

The shop produces custom kitchens, bathroom vanities, built-ins, entertainment centers, closets, custom shutters, doors, and one-off furniture pieces. Every cabinet is fabricated on-site, and the team handles design, finishing, and assembly. The company also offers installation across Mississippi, Alabama, and Louisiana, and ships finished pieces throughout the continental United States.

Customers include homeowners, interior decorators, and general contractors throughout the three-state area, as well as commercial clients outfitting offices and business spaces. Projects range from indoor and outdoor kitchens to bathroom remodels and custom storage solutions.

The Wood Mill emphasizes quality, affordability, and professionalism, with a focus on timely delivery and personalized design for each project. The business was built on the premise that locally made, custom cabinetry should be accessible without sacrificing craftsmanship.
